analysis_definition: Normalized trapezoidal integral of raw final population excess risk against log allocated total scalar-work budget; all five budgets and all 256 primary teachers retained.

development_selection.selection_rule: Smallest mean normalized raw-excess-risk/log-allocated-work AUC over all 16 development seeds and all five budgets; exact ties choose smaller LR.

groups.interpretation: Primary success requires all three one-sided upper 95% paired-t bounds below zero. Bootstrap is sensitivity only; secondary groups cannot establish primary success.
